title: Bomb Vest
description: Simply adds a craftable bomb vest that explodes when worn while burning.
body:
Use code **Radboi** to get 25% off your first month with [Bisect Hosting](https://bisecthosting.com/Radboi)
![Bisect Hosting discount](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d1dad3ad79a9c79b75b0a86ae03e5f6b3befe928_0.webp)

Adds a bomb vest, that is crafted with a TNT, a Leather Chestplate and a Lever. The vest gives a speed boost, so that you can run at your targets more easily. It explodes when you are burning.

(NOTE: fire takes some time to start the actual burning, so if you only touch a fire for one tick of a second, it wont work)
